snippet.title: The Moon Has Faded Away - A Lovecraftian PS1-style horror game about the disappearance of the moon!
snippet.description:
Download the demo on itch.io https://blue-bird-games.itch.io/the-moon-has-faded-away-demo?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt Content warning: May contain violence, gore, flashing lights, and loud sounds. It may also address sensitive topics such as suicide, etc.

After moving to a small apartment in a new city with his sister and mother due to work-related reasons, Alex's and his family's everyday life continues until an unprecedented event occurs: the disappearance of the moon.
